purpose: Read-only discovery of zero-cost SQLite execution and verification supply for the current database pressure mission.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil,sqlite3
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_apt_packages('sqlite',limit=30)
print(json.dumps({
  'python_sqlite3_version':sqlite3.sqlite_version,
  'sqlite3_cli_in_path':shutil.which('sqlite3'),
  'apt_candidates':out.get('candidates',[])[:30]
},sort_keys=True))
print('SQLITE_SUPPLY_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE')
PY
